instruction:
In useAppStore.js, find the uploadOptions object literal (around line 280). It currently has properties: includeShorts, includeMusic, includeMetadata, maxVideos, videosRoot, privacy, playlistName, dryRun, ffmpegBin, ffprobeBin. Add these 7 new properties after ffprobeBin:

extensions: "",
excludeDirectories: "",
excludeFiles: "",
requireUploadedOn: "",
requireMissingOn: "",
clientSecretsPath: "",
tokenFilePath: ""

Do not change any other part of the file. Just add these 7 string properties to the uploadOptions object.
diff:
--- changed files ---
app/useAppStore.js | 9 ++++++++-
 1 file changed, 8 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

--- diff ---
diff --git a/app/useAppStore.js b/app/useAppStore.js
index b52c9a4..b1f551e 100644
--- a/app/useAppStore.js
+++ b/app/useAppStore.js
@@ -295,7 +295,14 @@ export const useAppStore = create(function createAppStore(set, get)
             playlistName: "",
             dryRun: false,
             ffmpegBin: "",
-            ffprobeBin: ""
+            ffprobeBin: "",
+            extensions: "",
+            excludeDirectories: "",
+            excludeFiles: "",
+            requireUploadedOn: "",
+            requireMissingOn: "",
+            clientSecretsPath: "",
+            tokenFilePath: ""
         },
         setUploadPlatform: function setUploadPlatform(platformId, value)
         {
